description: Defines classes and functions for memory mapping allocators, including MapAllocator and RefcountedMapAllocator, with support for shared memory and file descriptors.

classes.name: MapAllocator
classes.description: Memory mapping allocator supporting various modes and file descriptor handling.

classes.name: RefcountedMapAllocator
classes.description: Reference-counted memory mapping allocator extending MapAllocator with ref management.

methods.name: MapAllocator
methods.description: Constructs a MapAllocator with filename, flags, and size.

methods.name: MapAllocator
methods.description: Constructs a MapAllocator with file descriptor and filename.

methods.name: filename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the allocator.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor; unsupported on Windows.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the mapped memory.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the mapped data.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Returns the flags used for mapping.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the allocator and releases resources.

methods.name: fromDataPtr
methods.description: Creates a MapAllocator from a DataPtr.

methods.name: makeDataPtr
methods.description: Creates a DataPtr from filename, flags, and size.

methods.name: RefcountedMapAllocator
methods.description: Constructs a refcounted memory allocator with filename, flags, and size.
